mapper.insert: insert into points_budget_usage (programme, period, issued_points, update_time) values (#{programme}, #{period}, 0, #{now}) on duplicate key update programme = programme
mapper.select: select event_type as "eventType", source_name as "sourceName", programme as "programme", daily_cap_points as "dailyCapPoints", status as "status", update_by as "updateBy", update_time as "updateTime" from points_award_cap order by event_type

select b.programme as "programme", b.programme_name as "programmeName", b.monthly_budget_points as "monthlyBudgetPoints", b.status as "status", coalesce(u.issued_points, 0) as "issuedPoints", b.update_by as "updateBy", b.update_time as "updateTime" from points_programme_budget b left join points_budget_usage u on u.programme = b.programme and u.period = #{period} order by b.programme
select coalesce(sum(point), 0) from ums_member where point > 0
